title: Newsroom board: build Kanbus types from shape data at runtime
description: Change lib/newsroom-board.ts so contentItemBoardConfig (and deskBoardConfig) emit one KanbanConfig type per enabled content shape, mapping each story to its shape's type and keeping the stage columns; fall back to the single content-item type when no shapes exist. Wire IssueTypeFilter for content items. Prefer this runtime mapping over generating Kanbus YAML; if a Kanbus UI limitation blocks it (e.g. per-type colors or icons), file it against Kanbus and note it here.
